Presentation.title: Sales presentation
Presentation.intro: A local CRM walkthrough. Changes, follow-up tasks and signatures are simulated and separate from existing leads.
Presentation.emptyHint: Add a lead or import sample contacts.
Presentation.routingHint: Match a source to an assignee; run this rule on the presentation records.
Presentation.signHint: A simulated signature, not an external signing service. Signed demo amounts and validity dates are locked.
Presentation.reportHint: Reports calculate from the current scene records, including edited probabilities and deal values.
Presentation.csvHint: CSV header: name,company,email,value,source. Text import, up to 50 contacts.
Presentation.csvError: Check five columns, nonempty names/company, unique emails and nonnegative values; maximum 50 contacts.
Presentation.taskHint: The task ID is simulated here. Actual Tasks provisioning remains pending.
Presentation.consent: I agree to this simulated offer.
Presentation.formError: Check the required fields and their length.
Presentation.taskConnectionError: Tasks could not be reached. Your draft is saved here; retry when the demo connection returns.
Presentation.taskConnectedHint: Created tasks appear in Tasks for this demo workspace, with the selected deal owner. Find them through suite search or notifications.
Presentation.taskReadOnly: This persona can review follow-ups. Switch to a sales colleague to create a task.
Presentation.quotePrintHint: The preview uses the current deal values. Choose Print, then Save as PDF in your browser. This is an illustrative quotation; no invoice or legally binding signature is created.
Presentation.quotePopupBlocked: The print window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this local demo and try again.
Presentation.stageDefinitionsHint: Rename and reorder demo stages, or add a custom stage. Moving a deal applies that stage’s default probability. Won/lost outcomes stay fixed; occupied custom stages cannot be removed.
Presentation.stageDefinitionError: Use a stage name of 1–60 characters and a probability from 0 to 100.
Presentation.stageDuplicateError: Another stage already has this name.
Presentation.csvSourceHint: Paste CSV text with a header and up to 50 contacts. Map your column names next; each contact needs name, company, email, value and source.
Presentation.csvSourceError: Check the CSV structure: header, at least five columns and 1–50 contacts. Quoted commas are supported.
Presentation.csvMappingHint: Choose a different source column for each field. Existing or repeated emails cannot be imported again.
Presentation.csvMappingError: Check unique column mappings, names/company, valid unique emails, numeric nonnegative values and source. No contacts were imported.
Presentation.csvReviewCount: Review {count} contacts before adding them to this workspace.
